title: The Persona Paradox: Medical Personas as Behavioral Priors in Clinical Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the PatientSafetyBench dataset, where LLM judges rank open-ended model responses to patient queries across dimensions of safety (harmfulness), helpfulness, and factual accuracy specifically within the 'bias or stigmatization' category.

Measured by calculating the frequency of high-urgency label assignments (bias toward escalation) and analyzing error asymmetry (over-triage vs. under-triage) in clinical decision-making tasks across different medical personas and interaction styles.
